_how_to: Copy this file, rename it, and edit. 'voice' and 'music' are the narration and the music track. 'media' is the pool of photos/clips to auto-pick from. 'must_include' pins specific files so they always appear. 'script' is your loose summary - each line becomes an on-screen graphic card, timed to the narration by matching words. Paths are file names on Bunny (or full URLs, or local paths when testing).
